# Ghost Town Ranch

> Ghost Town Ranch (GTR) is a lifestyle brand rooted in the American West, born in the high desert (Twentynine Palms / Joshua Tree, California). Frontier Modernism skincare, hand-poured candles, fragrance and home goods. COSMOS-certified formulas.

## Shop
- [Shop all](https://ghosttownranch.com/shop/): full range, prices and availability
- [Ritual](https://ghosttownranch.com/ritual/): candles and Ranch Water body + room fragrance, six scents
- [Routines](https://ghosttownranch.com/routines/): skincare and makeup-as-skincare
- [Wash House](https://ghosttownranch.com/wash-house/): hand and body wash, body care, hair care, refill system

## About
- [Wide Light](https://ghosttownranch.com/field-guide/): editorial pocket guides on scent, landscape and ritual
- [Wholesale](https://ghosttownranch.com/wholesale/): trade and hospitality
